From ฿350–1,400/night, sorted from the lightest price up.
introH2: 🏙️ Can you visit Pattani on a budget — and how do you pick a value stay?
introHtml: Pattani is a quiet southern city that sees few tourists, so room prices run lighter than in many provinces — clean private rooms go for a few hundred baht and dorm beds start at just ฿350 · The key to doing Pattani on a budget is to match the area to your plans, because the stays are spread across several zones — Rusamilae, next to PSU Pattani, is where the value stays cluster most, from apartments to budget 3-star hotels and whole-house rentals · the old-town heart around Anoru is walkable to the Central Mosque, the Lim Ko Niao Shrine and old shophouses · the Pattani riverside is quieter and has a stay with a pool · and if you want to escape the city there's a Sai Buri beachfront resort and a Nong Chik farm stay · This guide rounds up 9 budget Pattani stays we've reviewed, all scoring 8.1+, sorted from the lightest price up — each drawn from reading real guest reviews, with honest pros and cons, a 3-site price compare and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Pattani has no metro and no commercial airport of its own — most travellers fly into Hat Yai and transfer by road (about 1.5–2 hours), or drive/take a van. In town, driving or ride-hailing is easiest · The budget lodging zones in this guide: Rusamilae — next to and inside PSU Pattani, with restaurants and cafes, where the value stays cluster (Blue Lapan, BM, Southern View, The Stay Inn, Pattanipirom) · City centre / Anoru old town — Central Mosque, Lim Ko Niao Shrine, old shophouses (The Wood) · Pattani riverside — quiet, with a pool (River City) · Sai Buri beach / Nong Chik countryside — an out-of-town resort and a farm stay (Nee Ran Nee, Bakkahland) · For the Sai Buri and Nong Chik stays, a car is recommended, as public transport is limited and the distances are longer.

entries.type: 2-Star Hostel · dorm beds · inside PSU Pattani
entries.name: Blue Lapan Inn Pattani
entries.revCount: Score 8.6 · 20 reviews · hostel inside PSU Pattani, dorm beds from ฿350
entries.addr: 181 Charoenpradit Rd (Sai Maw), Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: We open with the cheapest stay in this guide — Blue Lapan Inn is a hostel inside the PSU Pattani campus, with dorm beds from just ฿350, scoring 8.6 from 20 reviews · It suits students, anyone visiting the university and budget travellers who don't need lots of facilities, with gender-separated dorms plus private rooms from a single up to a King if you want more privacy · Real reviews praise the cleanliness and the handy campus location · Honest caveats: it's a hostel with basic facilities, dorms share common space, and it sits in the Rusamilae area away from the old town, so you'll ride in.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: solo and on a budget? Book a dorm bed at ฿350 for the best value · as a couple, compare the private single/King — it may beat two dorm beds and gives you privacy · you'll find this one via an OTA name search rather than a fixed listing page, so double-check the name and location before you book.
pros: Cheapest in the guide — dorm beds from ฿350 · scores 8.6 from 20 reviews
Inside the PSU Pattani campus, handy for university visits/students
Both dorm beds and private rooms to suit your budget
Reviews praise the cleanliness and campus location (from reviews)
cons: A hostel with basic facilities
Dorms share common space — less private than a room

entries.type: 2-Star Farm Resort · Malay wooden houses · Nong Chik
entries.name: Bakkahland Farm and Resort
entries.revCount: Score 8.2 · 40 reviews · Malay wooden-house farm stay by the fields, Nong Chik
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Don Rak · Nong Chik · out of town
entries.addr: 54 Moo 4, Tambon Don Rak, Nong Chik District
entries.storyHtml: One of the cheapest picks here, and a rural one — Bakkahland Farm and Resort is a Malay-style wooden-house farm stay by the fields in Nong Chik District, from ฿500/night, scoring 8.2 from 40 reviews · Its draw is the raised wooden houses with balconies looking over the fields and garden, a quiet setting for escaping the city for a simple, natural stay, with rooms from a ฿500 Standard up to a Family Bungalow · Real reviews praise the atmosphere and the owner's warmth · Honest caveats: it's in Nong Chik out of town so you'll need a car, and it's a 2-star farm stay with basic facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for the full experience, pick a Bungalow (wooden house) with a balcony over the fields rather than a Standard room · bring a car, as it's out of town with little public transport · with a group, look at the Family Bungalow for a lower per-person cost.
pros: From ฿500 · Malay-style wooden houses by the fields, rural feel
Raised wooden houses with field- and garden-view balconies · family bungalow available
Friendly owner, reviews praise the atmosphere (from reviews)
Great for a simple getaway from the city
cons: In Nong Chik District out of town — you'll need a car
A 2-star farm stay with basic facilities
Little public transport — inconvenient without a car

entries.name: BM Pattani Apartment
entries.revCount: Score 9.0 · 47 reviews · best-value private rooms in the budget group, near PSU Pattani
entries.addr: Charoen Pradit Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: The best-value private room in the budget group, and a well-reviewed one — BM Pattani Apartment is a daily-rental apartment in the Rusamilae area, from ฿600/night, scoring 9.0 from 47 reviews (the most reviews of any cheap pick here) · Rooms have a fridge and water heater, and some have a terrace, making it a solid choice for budget travellers wanting a clean private room near PSU Pattani, for short or long stays · Real reviews praise the value and helpful staff · Honest caveats: it's an apartment with no hotel-style service, and single rooms are compact.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Studio with terrace is roomier for not much more — worth it over several nights · ask for the long-stay rate if you're around a while · avoid the single if you want more space.
pros: From ฿600 · scores 9.0 from 47 reviews — best value among private rooms
Clean rooms with a fridge and water heater, some with a terrace
Near PSU Pattani, good for short and long stays
The most-reviewed cheap pick here — plenty of real data (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: A budget stay that still puts you by the sea — Nee Ran Nee Resort is a budget beachfront resort in Sai Buri District, from ฿800/night, scoring 8.7 from 11 reviews · Its selling point is the spot near the beach plus rooms ranging from 2 guests up to a group room for 8 — very cheap per person with a big group, ideal for anyone wanting to get out of town for a seaside break · Real reviews praise the quiet atmosphere and value · Honest caveats: it's in Sai Buri District, a fair drive from Pattani city, and it's a 2-star resort with basic facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: coming as a group or a big family? Book a 6–8 guest room for a very low per-person cost · check the distance from town first, as it's out in Sai Buri — a car helps.

entries.storyHtml: A large 3-star hotel with light prices — Southern View Hotel is an 80-room hotel on Nong Chik Road, from just ฿900, with an Agoda score as high as 9.4 (Booking 8.6) · The draw is the large room count and easy availability even at short notice, plus value, with everything from Deluxe rooms up to a Suite, in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani — handy for anyone wanting a clean, budget room and driving themselves · Honest caveats: review numbers are still thin (5) as it's fairly new, and it's on Nong Chik Road, not the old town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Deluxe Queen at ฿900 is the best value for two; step up to the Suite only if you want a separate sitting area · with few reviews so far, read the latest ones and check the room photos before booking.

entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Deluxe room is bigger and brighter for not much more — worth it if you like an airy room · the city-centre spot makes finding a bite easy on foot.

entries.storyHtml: Budget prices but you get a pool — River City Hotel is a midrange riverside hotel with a pool and plenty of reviews (96), scoring 8.1, from ฿1,100 · Its selling point is the pool, which is rare among Pattani stays at this price, plus Superior rooms with a balcony over the river, and it's near both the city and PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the pool and location, though some note the rooms are dated · Honest caveats: pick a renovated room, and the overall 8.1 isn't as high as the boutiques in this group.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: choose a Superior River View for the balcony over the river, and ask about the room's condition when booking, as some are newer than others · handy with kids for the pool.

entries.storyHtml: A high-scoring whole-house rental that's great value with a group — The Stay Inn is a whole-house rental with 3 bedrooms sleeping around 6, scoring a high 9.4 from 20 reviews, from ฿1,300/night (whole house) · It has a full kitchen, washing machine, balcony and private parking, making it very cheap per person if you fill the house, in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the cleanliness and the value when split among several people · Honest caveats: it's a rental with no hotel-style service or all-hours check-in, and it has fewer reviews than the city hotels.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: fill the house and the per-person cost beats booking several hotel rooms · ask for the long-stay rate for a longer trip · with a kitchen and washing machine, you'll save on meals and laundry.

noteHtml: 📌 Note: all prices are approximate starting rates and may change by date and season — always check live prices and compare the 3 sites before booking · The scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on the booking platforms, not from staying ourselves · Every stay here scores 8.1+ but they are budget 2–3 star places, so they have price-appropriate limits — hostels share common space, some have no pool, and some sit out of town or beyond the district and aren't walkable to the sights, so read each one's caveats before booking · Blue Lapan Inn is found via an OTA name search (not a fixed listing page), and the Trip.com link for The Stay Inn opens the Pattani hotel list — for these two, double-check the name and location before you book · Pattani has no airport of its own; most travellers fly into Hat Yai and transfer by road (about 1.5–2 hours), or drive/take a van · In town, driving yourself or ride-hailing is easiest · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about budget Pattani hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which budget Pattani stay is the best value?
faq.a: On lowest price, Blue Lapan Inn with dorm beds from ฿350 (score 8.6) is the cheapest here · For the best-value private room, BM Pattani Apartment at ฿600 scores 9.0 from 47 reviews — the strongest value among private rooms · The highest scores in the set are Southern View (9.4 Agoda · ฿900) and The Stay Inn (9.4 · ฿1,300 whole house).

faq.q: ❓ How much do budget Pattani hotels cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start at roughly ฿350–1,400 per night · At the lightest end are Blue Lapan ฿350 (dorm bed), Bakkahland ฿500, BM Apartment ฿600, Nee Ran Nee ฿800 and Southern View ฿900 · On the boutique/pool/whole-house side are The Wood and River City ฿1,100, The Stay Inn ฿1,300 (whole house) and Pattanipirom ฿1,400 · All are approximate starting rates; long weekends and festivals can push them higher.

faq.q: ❓ On a budget in Pattani, which area should I stay in?
faq.a: Rusamilae, near PSU Pattani, is where the value stays cluster most (Blue Lapan, BM Apartment, Southern View, The Stay Inn, Pattanipirom) · The city centre is walkable to the old town (The Wood) · The riverside is quiet and has a pool (River City) · And to get out of town there's a Sai Buri beachfront resort (Nee Ran Nee) and a Nong Chik farm stay (Bakkahland).

faq.q: ❓ Visiting PSU Pattani on a budget — where should I stay?
faq.a: The Rusamilae area near and inside PSU Pattani has several cheap stays · Blue Lapan Inn is right on campus, with dorm beds from ฿350 · BM Pattani Apartment ฿600 and Southern View ฿900 are near the university · With a group, The Stay Inn at ฿1,300 (whole house) is better value.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Pattani as a group or big family on a budget?
faq.a: With several people, The Stay Inn is a whole-house rental with 3 bedrooms sleeping ~6 at ฿1,300, with a kitchen and washing machine — very good per-person value · Nee Ran Nee Resort in Sai Buri has group rooms for up to 8 from ฿800 · Or Bakkahland has a Family Bungalow from ฿500.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking budget Pattani hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion and season, so it's worth comparing all three before every booking — most stays here compare across all three sites, while Blue Lapan Inn is found via an OTA name search and the Trip.com link for The Stay Inn opens the Pattani hotel list, so double-check the name and location for those two · Each review page in this guide has the price-compare links.
